{{Top|leg}}
The '''redgill fish''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Fish/Legends|fish]] found on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]].<ref name="Backlash">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Backlash]]''</ref> In [[43 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Backlash]]'' to [[43 ABY]].</ref> [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Ben Skywalker]] used redgill fish as the main ingredient in a [[Stew/Legends|stew]], combining them with sliced tree tubers from the rainforest and tart clusterfruit leaves.<ref name="Backlash" />

==Appearances==
*''[[Fate of the Jedi: Backlash]]'' {{1st}}
